title: Lo jaa raha hai kafla
body:
Lo jaa raha hai kafla
Ashur ki raat guzar gayi, aur gyaraa muharram agayi.
Kaydi bani ale nabi.
Ye dekh ke royi binte zehra (gar lut gaya hussain ka) x2
Zindaan raha islam
<<MINI>>
(Lo jaa raha hai kafla zindaane shaam) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
(Zainab ki be ridaai pe) x2 Rota huwa har gaam
<<MINI>>
(Lo jaa raha hai kafla zindaane shaam) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Rukhsat karo bhayya muje lo akhri mera salaam.
Basti basti karya karya (ponchayengi zainab bayaan) x2
(gar lut gaya hussain ka) x2
Zindaan raha islam
<<MINI>>
(Lo jaa raha hai kafla zindaane shaam) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Me be ridaa tu be kafan sadmo se ye dil chaak hai.
Meri ridaa bhi khaak he (tera kafan bhi khaak he) x2
(Ye imtihaan dasht tha) x2
Wo imtihaan-e-shaam
<<MINI>>
(Lo jaa raha hai kafla zindaane shaam) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Kisko bulawungi bhalaa ye to bataa ab kawn hai.
Jis wakt puchenga laayin (tumne se zainab kon hai) x2
(Saydaniyya sab royengi) x2
Le le ke tera naam
<<MINI>>
(Lo jaa raha hai kafla zindaane shaam) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Shikwaa karengi ye behen jab raah mei takdeer se.
Uthengi matam ki sadaa (sajjad ki zanjeer se) x2
(Rowengi mere haal pe) x2
Ye gardishe ayaam
<<MINI>>
(Lo jaa raha hai kafla zindaane shaam) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab rowengi zanjeer to raaho ke pathar rowenge.
Zainab wahaa par aur yaha(n) (lashe bahattar royenge) x2
(bhayya jigar phat jayenga) x2
sehte huwe alaam
<<MINI>>
(Lo jaa raha hai kafla zindaane shaam) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Mujpar meri tanhaayi bhi nawha karengi raah me. Nake se jab wo ladli (beti girengi raah me) x2 (Ik roz usko qayd me) x2 miljayanga araam
<<MINI>>
(Lo jaa raha hai kafla zindaane shaam) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri sakina qayd me dam tor dengi ek din. Dunya tumhari chaah me (wo chor dengi ek din) x2 (barpa sitam ki qayd me) x2 Ho jayenga kohraam
<<MINI>>
(Lo jaa raha hai kafla zindaane shaam) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Balo me khaak bazuwo me resma lab par bukaa.
Bhayya nabi ki aal ko (dekhengi dunya be ridaa) x2
(Bhayya masaaib is kadr) x2
Dengi ye raah-e-shaam
<<MINI>>
(Lo jaa raha hai kafla zindaane shaam) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Sunkar fugaa hamshir ki lasha tarap kar rehgaya.
Ane lagi us lashaye (be sar se ye purgham sadaa) x2
(Zainab sare neza mera) x2
Sar jaayenga har ghaam
<<MINI>>
(Lo jaa raha hai kafla zindaane shaam) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
(Zainab ki be ridaai pe) x2 Rota huwa har ghaam
<<MINI>>
(Lo jaa raha hai kafla zindaane shaam) x4
